notes.title: 🎉 We're part of Steam Next Fest – Play the demo now! 🎮
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We're excited to announce that our game "Train Your Fingers - Lab" is taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, running from June 9th to 16th!

🎮 The demo is already available for download, so you don’t have to wait – jump in and try it out today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703210/Train_Your_Fingers__Lab_Demo/

🗓️ During the Fest, we’ll be around to answer your questions, hear your feedback, and connect with the community.

If you enjoy the demo, don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist – it helps us a lot! 💚

👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692200/Train_Your_Fingers__Lab/

Thanks for your support and see you at the Fest!
– Jan Kuta & Jana Kutova
